biggest_catch: This is a standing direct-deposit campaign, not a one-time signup bonus: you must route new qualifying payroll/government direct deposits through First Tech for 3 consecutive months, and the $300 tier requires over $5,000 per month in direct deposits (the $1,000-$5,000 tier pays only $50).
catches: Tiered by monthly direct deposit: $50 for $1,000-$5,000/month; $300 for over $5,000/month in qualifying direct deposits.
Direct deposits must be NEW (no direct deposit activity in the past 18 months) and occur at least once per calendar month for 3 consecutive months starting with the first direct deposit.

Qualifying deposits must be from employer payroll or approved government benefits (e.g. Social Security). Nonqualifying: checks, wires, internal transfers, P2P payments, merchant transactions, digital banking transfers from another institution, tax refunds.
Accounts are reviewed after a 90-day evaluation period; bonuses are paid into the Membership Savings account the first week after the month in which the Qualification Period ends.
Accounts and membership must remain active and in good standing through bonus receipt; bonuses may be reported on IRS Form 1099.
Must be the primary account owner on a First Tech Premier Rewards Checking (plus Premier Rewards Savings) account; business, organization, and HSA accounts are not eligible.

First Tech membership required: employees of 900+ partner companies (Amazon, Microsoft, Intel, etc.), family/household of members, State of Oregon employees, Lane County OR residents, or anyone who joins the Computer History Museum (small annual fee — confirm current dues) or Financial Fitness Association (small annual fee — confirm current dues) — note those org memberships cost a small annual fee.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to join; the only costs are optional third-party organization memberships ($8-$15/yr) if using that eligibility path — disclosed, and a standard $5 credit-union share deposit, not a fee.

c4.evidence: Official disclosure: 'Bonuses are paid into the Membership Savings account the first week after the month in which the Qualification Period ends.'

steps: Become a First Tech Federal Credit Union member (partner-company employment, family of a member, Lane County OR, State of Oregon, or join the Financial Fitness Association for $8/yr or Computer History Museum for $15/yr).
Open a First Tech Premier Rewards Checking account (with the linked Premier Rewards Savings account) as the primary owner.
Set up a NEW qualifying direct deposit (employer payroll or approved government benefits — no DD activity in the past 18 months): $1,000-$5,000/month earns $50; over $5,000/month earns $300.
Receive the qualifying direct deposit at least once per calendar month for 3 consecutive months.
Keep the accounts and membership active and in good standing; the bonus is paid into your Membership Savings account the first week after the month the qualification period ends.
